title: Query log and gap detection
result: placement resolved as the registry directory (`synthesis/queries/<day>.jsonl`), which `sync-all-safe` now carries (dotfiles `9e75805`); ids, scores and lanes only, never evidence text. `atrium gaps` lists questions whose best reranked logit is under 0 or that got nothing (flags 28/42 missed and 5/46 answered holdout questions), most-asked first, plus the records served most. The gap list is the proposal list: a gap is by definition something the memory cannot draft, so the note is written by whoever answers it.
evidence: `d321af1`; `tests/test_gaps.py`, `tests/test_query_log.py`; live `atrium context` wrote a line and `atrium gaps --days 1` read it.
